name: carousel-vision-2
title: Vision Carousel, Face On
description: Cards slide past in a wide band, turned face on, with perspective only at the ends. The ring tilt and card fan are variables. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.
useWhen: A set of products, menu items, categories or tiles should take turns in front of the camera as a showcase.
A calm band of big cards is wanted.
avoidWhen: The cards should circle in a flat ring: use a circle carousel.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Card titles
variables.description: Comma- or line-separated titles, one per card, repeated if there are fewer than the 12 cards. A shop can list its products.
variables.default: Linen Shirt, Ceramic Mug, Canvas Tote, Oak Stool, Wool Throw, Glass Vase, Field Notebook, Desk Mat, Soy Candle, Clay Planter, Tea Set, Cutting Board

variables.label: Card colours
variables.description: Comma-separated colours for the drawn cards, cycled in order. Title and glyph colour follow each card's brightness.

variables.label: Images
variables.description: Optional JSON array of image URLs or paths, e.g. ["a.jpg","b.jpg"]. When set, photos replace the drawn cards (they are fitted into square cards and repeated if there are fewer than 12); titles, colours and glyphs then do not apply. Empty by default.

variables.label: Glyphs
variables.description: Draw a simple line glyph on each drawn card.

variables.label: Corner radius
variables.description: Card corner rounding as a share of the card size.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Time scale of the carousel motion. 1 is the designed pace.

variables.label: Ring tilt
variables.description: How far the ring is turned about its horizontal axis. -90 shows the cards face on; smaller magnitudes tip the ring so the back row peeks above.

variables.label: Card fan
variables.description: How far cards turn toward the centre as they move away from it. 0 keeps them flat.
